responsibility: This header defines GCC’s checking-build selftest framework API and assertion macros. It introduces the selftest::location type for reporting failures, declarations for the selftest runner, pass/fail/reporting utilities, temporary-file and quote-fixing helpers, line-table test support, file-reading helpers, and the ASSERT_* macro family used throughout GCC source files to embed deterministic unit-style tests.
same_name_distinction: This .h file is the public API layer for GCC selftests, defining location, assertion macros, and helper class/function declarations, whereas gcc/selftest.cc provides their runtime behavior and support code.
